name: Issue Triage Guide
description: Example agent that summarizes incoming issues, highlights missing reproduction details, and suggests consistent project labels.

setup.instructions: Add the example instructions to an agent with read-only issue access and replace the sample labels with labels that exist in your repository.

usage.instructions: Give the agent a single issue at a time and have a maintainer confirm suggested labels and replies before anything is posted.
usage.example: Summarize issue #42, identify information needed to reproduce it, and suggest up to three existing labels.
